review_runs.summary: Selected sources teach plural formation and identifiable-group reference clearly, with contextual examples and changed-context practice. Main defect: picnic choice treats first mention as sufficient to exclude a definite plural, despite shared-situation definiteness being explicitly taught. Other defects concern unexplained terminology, one malformed grammatical label, and an internal-sounding heading. All selected keyed sources reviewed; sources not identified below have no grounded defect. Reviewed all 10 exercises; each serves obj-noun-plurals-01. Tasks directly practice recognizing or forming indefinite and definite plurals through regular endings, zero-ending neuter nouns, irregular forms, reference tracking, error correction, and contextual application. Focused exercises validly target individual subskills.
